set.body:
Migrated from canardlapin/scalafim Mote bd-01KY5172VC7RCNBGTA02S9V96Z on 2026-08-01 after HalfFlow ownership moved to canardlapin/reframe4s.
Source status: closed. Source created_at: 2026-07-22T13:46:04.524180Z.

Implement one-window squared neighborhood CC and its adjoint-box intensity derivative without autodiff.

Acceptance gate:
- The optimized CC value matches a naive overlapping-window implementation for radius 2 and 3, randomized volumes, partial support, flat windows, anticorrelated inputs, and boundary windows.
- Support and variance/reliability weights are explicitly frozen during each derivative and trial-acceptance calculation. If weights are refreshed after acceptance, the behavior is documented as IRLS rather than called an exact joint derivative.
- Denominator stabilization is scale-aware and tested under intensity gain, offset, and constant-image cases.
- The analytic intensity gradient passes a central finite-difference epsilon ladder: best relative error <= 1e-5 on smooth interior fixtures and <= 1e-3 on whole-domain boundary fixtures, with a visible convergence region rather than one cherry-picked epsilon.
- Fixed/moving swap and affine intensity gain/offset metamorphic checks hold within declared tolerances.
- The objective emits total loss, active fraction, edge-band active fraction, support distribution, and variance-reliability diagnostics.
- The held-out moving evaluation mask and labels are absent from every objective code path.
- Shared JVM and Scala.js value/gradient suites pass.
set.title: HalfFlow-CC G2: true neighborhood CC value and adjoint derivative
